criteria.name: Systematic diagnosis
criteria.positive_evidence: Reproduces the failure and narrows the cause.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Mentions investigation without explaining a method.

criteria.name: Diagnostic investigation
criteria.positive_evidence: Uses relevant logs, comparisons or other diagnostic information.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Does not identify how diagnostic information would be obtained.

criteria.name: Reasoned correction
criteria.positive_evidence: Connects the proposed correction to an identified cause.
criteria.negative_evidence: Proposes an unsupported change without diagnosing the problem.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Mentions fixing the problem without explaining the reasoning.

criteria.name: Verification
criteria.positive_evidence: Tests the correction and checks for related regressions.
criteria.negative_evidence: Explicitly rejects verification or treats absence of complaints as proof.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Promises to check the result without describing a verification method.

decision_rules.ADVANCE: All four criteria contain sufficient positive evidence.
decision_rules.DO_NOT_ADVANCE: The response contains explicit material evidence of unsafe or deficient practice against one or more critical criteria.
decision_rules.DEFER: Neither a positive nor a negative recommendation is sufficiently supported.

notes: Pilot-only rules. Not independently validated for real recruitment.
